execution_precondition: after both family live acceptances and explicit root assignment; stop/hold overrides
limits: no full database hash/reader, fit/member/source-corpus/tree census, signal or activation
all differences remain reported for root attribution; authorized history is not silently waived
file-returned bytes measured separately; SQL result JSON size is not SQLite pager or device bytes

review.independent_native_source_review: clear after partial-I/O reporting fix; report attributed, no separate reviewer file

review.inverse: independent in-memory inverse restores entire original source
